messages.content: Review a proposed autonomous coding context packet for whether a smaller tool-using model can act correctly on its first turn. Return only the contracted JSON.

Observed failures: agents listed the repository instead of editing focus files, read stale mission records, repeated already-applied edits, copied rendered line numbers into byte-exact edit searches, and guessed APIs. Proposed deterministic packet fields: identity; objective; machineChecks {verifyCommand, acceptanceCommand, baseline outputs}; lane {territory, focusPaths, writablePaths, readablePaths, protected/excluded paths}; targetArtifacts (including required files not yet created); evidenceArtifacts [{path, role, digest, exact unnumbered text}] containing focus files, command-mentioned tests, applicable AGENTS/CLAUDE instructions, package manifest, and relative-import interfaces; repositoryMap; priorVerifiedKnowledge; currentFailureResidue; firstMoves; and exact one-action JSON output contract. Artifact collection is bounded by per-file and total byte budgets, never silently slices the objective, and names omitted/truncated artifacts. Identify missing information, dangerous excess, and decisive tests.

completion.text: {"missing":["clear delineation of roles for the models involved","specific formats for handling paths and file references","error handling protocols for invalid inputs","detailed definitions for each packet field"],"removeOrBound":["redundant checks that increase processing time","excessive verbosity in evidence artifacts","non-deterministic elements that could lead to varied outputs"],"strengths":["focus on deterministic outputs","clear definition of machine checks","consideration for writable/readable paths"],"tests":["verify that agents can successfully edit the focus files on the first turn","test for proper handling of stale records with fresh data","ensure that no redundant edits are applied if already done","check the accuracy of API guesses against a predefined list"]}
